input.source_text_en: If the AMF indicates active time value to the UE, AMF should not indicate "all PLMN registration area allocated" indication in the MICO indication IE to the UE.
input.question_ko: AMF가 UE에 active time value를 알릴 때 MICO indication IE의 all-PLMN 표시에 관한 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF and W-AGF may be configured with a different TAI value or with the same TAI value as other N3IWFs, TNGFs, TWIFs and/or W-AGFs.
input.question_ko: N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF, W-AGF 사이의 TAI value 구성 관계를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: When a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K AMF, the target AMF includes the 8 least significant bits of the downlink NAS COUNT in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE, and indicates that a new KAMF shall not be derived (see subclause 9.11.2.6).
input.question_ko: 동일한 K_AMF로 새 5G NAS security context를 유도할 때 target AMF가 새 K_AMF 유도 여부를 어떻게 표시하는지 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: When the 5GS supports the Paging Policy Differentiation (PPD) feature, the DSCP value (TOS in IPv4 / TC in IPv6) is set by the application to indicate to the 5GS which Paging Policy should be applied for a certain IP packet.
input.question_ko: 5GS가 Paging Policy Differentiation을 지원할 때 특정 IP packet에 적용할 Paging Policy를 표시하는 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) was started upon reception of the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, the UE may remove the S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI including S-NSSAI(s) with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached", if the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) expires.
input.question_ko: 최대 UE 수 도달 사유의 S-NSSAI와 연관된 T3526이 만료될 때 UE의 처리를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The AMF should set the value of the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer based on the unavailability period duration and the start of the unavailability period.
input.question_ko: AMF가 unavailability period 정보를 이용해 mobile reachable timer와 implicit deregistration timer를 설정하는 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: A special case where the 5GS can act as a sub-network is when the 5GS acts as a TSN network, which is supported by the 3GPP specifications based on the architecture in clause 4.4.8.2.
input.question_ko: 5GS가 TSN network로 동작할 때의 sub-network 역할을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the AMF does not provide the Unavailability configuration IE or the AMF sets the EUPR bit value in the Unavailability configuration IE to "UE needs to report end of unavailability period", the UE should trigger registration procedure for mobility registration update when the unavailability period duration has ended.
input.question_ko: Unavailability configuration IE가 없거나 EUPR이 종료 보고를 요구할 때 unavailability period 종료 후 UE 동작을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: However, when the UE operating in dual-registration mode performs an initial registration procedure, it shall take into use a 5G NAS security context and follow the handling of this security context as described in the present specification.
input.question_ko: dual-registration mode UE가 initial registration을 수행할 때 5G NAS security context를 어떻게 처리하는지 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: A new 5G NAS security context may also be created during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover.
input.question_ko: N1 mode 간 handover 중 새로운 5G NAS security context의 생성 시점을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The UE shall not use the entering of a Non-Allowed Area as a criterion for Cell Reselection, a trigger for PLMN Selection or Domain selection for UE originating sessions or calls.
input.question_ko: UE가 Non-Allowed Area에 진입한 사실을 cell·PLMN·domain 선택에 사용하는 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The 5G NAS security context which is indicated by an ngKSI can be taken into use to establish the secure exchange of NAS messages when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without executing a new primary authentication and key agreement procedure (see subclause 5.4.1) or when the AMF initiates a security mode control procedure.
input.question_ko: ngKSI가 가리키는 5G NAS security context를 새 인증 없이 사용하는 상황을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The configured NSSAI and the rejected NSSAI may be changed during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure.
input.question_ko: configured NSSAI와 rejected NSSAI의 변경 절차를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: In the present document, when the UE is required to delete an ngKSI, the UE shall set the ngKSI to the value "no key is available" and consider also the associated keys K AMF or K'AMF, 5G NAS ciphering key and 5G NAS integrity key invalid (i.e. the 5G NAS security context associated with the ngKSI as no longer valid).
input.question_ko: UE의 ngKSI 삭제 상황에서 ngKSI와 연관 키를 어떻게 처리하는지 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The network should not move the UE to another available PLMN/SNPN, e.g. by handover, as long as the selected PLMN/SNPN is available to serve the UE's location.
input.question_ko: 선택된 PLMN 또는 SNPN이 UE 위치에서 계속 서비스를 제공하는 동안 다른 network로 이동시키는 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: To enable an emergency call back, the UE should wait for a UE implementation-specific duration of time before requesting the use of MICO mode after the completion of the emergency services.
input.question_ko: emergency service 완료 후 emergency callback을 지원하기 위해 UE가 MICO mode를 요청하기 전 취할 동작을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The UE can provide the SOR transparent container IE during the registration procedure to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
input.question_ko: registration procedure에서 UE가 SOR transparent container IE를 network에 전달하는 방법을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The network instance for the N6 interface (clause 5.6.12) may be indicated by the SMF to the UPF for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment procedure.
input.question_ko: PDU Session establishment 중 N6 interface의 network instance를 UPF에 전달하는 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: To redirect a UE from 5GC to EPC, when the UE sends a Registration Request or Service Request, the AMF sends a Registration Reject or Service Reject with an EMM cause value indicating that the UE should not use 5GC.
input.question_ko: UE를 5GC에서 EPC로 redirect할 때 AMF가 reject message의 EMM cause로 전달하는 5GC 사용 지침을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If a UDSF is shared between several NFs not part of the same set or is shared between several NF sets, it is up to UDSF implementation and deployment to make sure that only NFs that are authorized can access the data.
input.question_ko: 여러 NF 또는 NF set이 UDSF를 공유할 때 데이터 접근 범위를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: A UE that accesses the 5G Core Network over a non-3GPP access shall, after UE registration, support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point.
input.question_ko: non-3GPP access로 5G Core Network에 접근하는 UE의 등록 후 NAS signalling 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the UE is authorized to use V2X communication over PC5 reference point based on: a) at least one of the following bits in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message set by the UE, or already stored in the 5GMM context in the AMF during the previous registration procedure as follows: 1) the V2XCEPC5 bit to "V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5 supported"; or 2) the V2XCNPC5 bit to "V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported"; and b) the user's subscription context obtained from the UDM as defined in 3GPP TS 23.287 [6C]; the AMF should not immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure.
input.question_ko: UE가 capability bit와 subscription context에 따라 PC5 기반 V2X communication 권한을 가진 경우 registration 완료 후 NAS signalling connection 처리 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: In the initial registration procedure, when the key K AUSF, is invalid, the UE shall delete the ngKSI.
input.question_ko: initial registration 중 K_AUSF가 유효하지 않을 때 UE의 ngKSI 처리를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane shall only use service-based interfaces for their interactions.
input.question_ko: 5GC Control Plane 내부 Network Function 간 상호작용 인터페이스 원칙을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The emergency PDU session shall not be released.
input.question_ko: emergency PDU session의 release 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: A non-3GPP access network may advertise the PLMNs or SNPNs for which it supports trusted connectivity and the type of supported trusted connectivity (e.g. "5G connectivity").
input.question_ko: non-3GPP access network가 trusted connectivity 지원 정보를 광고하는 범위를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: UEs that are not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking may be served by entities not dedicated for interworking, i.e. by either by PGW or SMF/UPF.
input.question_ko: 5GS와 EPC interworking 대상이 아닌 UE의 serving entity 구성을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: However, each SMF may also have the capability to control both a local and a central UPF within a PDU Session.
input.question_ko: 하나의 PDU Session에서 SMF가 local UPF와 central UPF를 제어하는 구성을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: This current 5G NAS security context can be of type native or mapped, i.e. originating from a native 5G NAS security context or mapped 5G NAS security context.
input.question_ko: current 5G NAS security context의 유형을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: When AMF allocates registration area for UE registered for Disaster Roaming service as specified in clause 5.40.4, AMF shall only consider TAIs covering the area with the Disaster Condition.
input.question_ko: Disaster Roaming service에 등록된 UE의 registration area를 AMF가 할당할 때 고려할 TAI 범위를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The architecture does not require the DS-TT functionality to be supported in the device nor require the user plane NWTT functionality to be supported in the UPF, however, it can co-exist with such functions.
input.question_ko: 5GS architecture와 DS-TT 또는 NW-TT function의 공존 관계를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Each NF Service Consumer accessing the UDR, via Nudr, shall be able to add, modify, update or delete only the data it is authorised to change.
input.question_ko: Nudr를 통해 UDR에 접근하는 NF Service Consumer의 데이터 변경 범위를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the following: a) requests for emergency services; b) requests for emergency services fallback; c) requests from UEs configured for high priority access in selected PLMN or SNPN; d) DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message; e) requests for mobile terminated services, triggered by paging or a notification procedure; f) requests for initial registration or mobility and periodic registration update, when emergency is indicated by lower layers; and g) requests for mobility registration update when the UE is reporting unavailability information due to discontinuous coverage.
input.question_ko: 5GMM signalling congestion 상황에서 AMF가 예외적으로 다루는 request 범주를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: A UE simultaneously connected to the same 5G Core Network of a PLMN/SNPN over a 3GPP access and a non-3GPP access shall be served by a single AMF in this 5G Core Network.
input.question_ko: 동일한 5G Core Network에 3GPP access와 non-3GPP access로 동시에 연결된 UE의 AMF 구성을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network was correct, the network should terminate the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message (see subclause 5.4.1.3.5).
input.question_ko: network의 5G-GUTI와 SUPI mapping이 올바른 경우 진행 중인 5G AKA 절차 처리를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the UE has not received any NSAG Information from the AMF, the UE shall not use Network Slice based cell reselection and Random Access at all.
input.question_ko: AMF에서 NSAG Information을 받지 못한 UE의 Network Slice 기반 cell reselection과 Random Access 처리를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The AMF should not reject Registration Request message for Mobility Registration Update that are performed when the UE is already in CM-CONNECTED state.
input.question_ko: 이미 CM-CONNECTED인 UE가 Mobility Registration Update용 Registration Request를 보낼 때 AMF의 reject 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the UE does not indicate preference for MICO mode during Registration procedure, the AMF shall not activate MICO mode for this UE.
input.question_ko: registration 중 UE가 MICO mode 선호를 표시하지 않았을 때 AMF의 MICO mode 처리를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: In order to enforce all primary RAT restrictions, the related RAT has to be deployed in different Tracking Area Codes and the subscriber shall not be allowed to access the network in TAs using the particular RAT.
input.question_ko: primary RAT restriction을 적용할 때 subscriber의 해당 RAT 기반 TA 접근 제한을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Forbidden Areas should not be used for Untrusted or Trusted non-3GPP access.
input.question_ko: Forbidden Area를 untrusted 또는 trusted non-3GPP access에 적용하는 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the disabling of N1 mode capability for 3GPP access was due to no network slices available, the UE should memorize the identity of the PLMN or SNPN where N1 mode is disabled due to no available network slices or the list of SNPNs where N1 mode is disabled due to no available network slices, respectively.
input.question_ko: 사용 가능한 network slice가 없어 N1 mode가 비활성화된 경우 UE가 PLMN·SNPN 정보를 기억하는 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Once the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the receiving 5GMM entity in the UE shall not process any NAS signalling messages unless they have been successfully integrity checked by the NAS.
input.question_ko: secure NAS message exchange가 설정된 뒤 UE receiving 5GMM entity의 NAS signalling message 처리 조건을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Not all events can be subscribed to UPF directly.
input.question_ko: event를 UPF에 직접 subscribe하는 기능의 적용 범위를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: A dual-registered UE should not send its E-UTRA connected to 5GC and E-UTRAN radio capabilities to NR access when connected to 5GS/NR to avoid being handed over to 5GC-connected E-UTRA or to E-UTRAN.
input.question_ko: dual-registered UE가 5GS/NR에 연결됐을 때 NR access로 전송할 E-UTRA·E-UTRAN radio capability 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the UE does not include a 5G-GUTI, the SUCI shall be used for the new registration.
input.question_ko: UE가 5G-GUTI를 포함하지 않은 경우 새 등록에 사용할 식별자를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: To avoid paging in the entire PLMN, when the AMF allocates the Active Time the AMF should not allocate "all PLMN" registration area to the UE.
input.question_ko: 전체 PLMN paging을 피하기 위해 AMF가 Active Time을 할당할 때 registration area를 정하는 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Before security can be activated, the AMF and the UE need to establish a 5G NAS security context.
input.question_ko: 5G NAS security를 활성화하기 전에 AMF와 UE가 충족해야 하는 전제조건을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: As described in subclause 4.8 in order to interwork with E-UTRAN connected to EPC, the UE supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode can operate in either single-registration mode or dual-registration mode.
input.question_ko: S1 mode와 N1 mode를 모두 지원하는 UE의 registration mode 운용 선택지를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The default configured NSSAI may be changed by sending a UE parameters update transparent container to the UE during the NAS transport procedure.
input.question_ko: NAS transport procedure 중 default configured NSSAI를 변경하는 방법을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: When the UE operating in single-registration mode in a network supporting N26 interface has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services and has no current EPS security context, the AMF shall set 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as the selected 5G NAS security algorithms in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE.
input.question_ko: N26 지원망의 single-registration mode UE가 emergency bearer PDN connection은 있지만 현재 EPS security context가 없을 때 AMF의 알고리즘 설정을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: When a N5CW device performs an EAP-based access authentication procedure to connect to a trusted WLAN access network, the N5CW device may simultaneously be registered to a 5GC of a PLMN or SNPN.
input.question_ko: N5CW device가 trusted WLAN 연결을 위해 EAP 기반 access authentication을 수행할 때 5GC 등록 상태를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The Registration Area of a UE in the Non-Allowed Area should consist of a set of TAs which belongs to a NonAllowed Area of the UE.
input.question_ko: Non-Allowed Area에 있는 UE의 Registration Area를 구성하는 TA 범위를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The number of S-NSSAIs included in the partially allowed NSSAI or the partially rejected NSSAI shall not exceed 7.
input.question_ko: partially allowed 또는 partially rejected NSSAI의 S-NSSAI 개수 상한을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the NG-RAN node takes a decision to initiate UAC because of the reception of the N2 interface OVERLOAD START messages, the NG-RAN should only initiate such procedure if all the AMFs relevant to the request contained in the OVERLOAD START message and connected to this NG-RAN node request to restrict the load for UEs that access the network.
input.question_ko: N2 OVERLOAD START 수신으로 UAC를 시작하려는 NG-RAN node가 확인할 AMF 조건을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.
input.question_ko: PLMN 운용 제한 지역과 관련된 UE 요청을 AMF가 처리할 때 필요한 위치정보 조건을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The AMF shall define an ngKSI for the newly derived K'AMF key such that the value field is taken from the eKSI of the KASME key and the type field is set to indicate a mapped security context and associate this ngKSI with the newly created mapped 5G NAS security context.
input.question_ko: 새로 유도한 K'_AMF에 대해 AMF가 ngKSI를 정의하고 연결하는 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the UE is performing registration over one access and intends to perform registration over the other access in the same PLMN (e.g. the 3GPP access and the selected N3IWF, TNGF or W-AGF are located in the same PLMN), the UE shall not initiate the registration over the other access until the Registration procedure over first access is completed.
input.question_ko: UE가 같은 PLMN의 한 access에서 등록 중 다른 access 등록도 하려는 경우 시작 시점을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The UE should not request to join a multicast MBS session for local MBS service if neither current TAI nor CGI of the current cell is part of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session, if the UE has valid information of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session.
input.question_ko: 현재 TAI와 cell CGI가 multicast MBS session service area에 없고 UE가 유효한 area 정보를 가진 경우 join request 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: In addition, the HPLMN may configure a UE with a single default configured NSSAI and consider the default configured NSSAI as valid in a PLMN for which the UE has neither a configured NSSAI nor an allowed NSSAI.
input.question_ko: UE에 configured NSSAI와 allowed NSSAI가 모두 없는 PLMN에서 HPLMN의 default configured NSSAI 처리를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The allowed NSSAI(s) should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME as specified in annex C.
input.question_ko: allowed NSSAI를 ME에 저장하는 위치와 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: For the case when the UE has an emergency PDU session and integrity check fails, the AMF may skip the authentication procedure even if no 5G NAS security context is available and proceed directly to the execution of the security mode control procedure as specified in subclause 5.4.2.
input.question_ko: emergency PDU session이 있는 UE의 integrity check가 실패했을 때 AMF의 authentication 및 security mode control 처리를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: To this purpose, the 5GSM messages can be transmitted in an information element in the 5GMM transport messages.
input.question_ko: 5GSM message를 5GMM transport message로 전달하는 방식을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: In uncongested scenarios, 98 percent of the packets should not experience a delay exceeding the 5QI's PDB.
input.question_ko: 혼잡하지 않은 상황에서 5QI Packet Delay Budget을 초과하는 packet delay 비율 기준을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The UE should memorize the identity of the PLMNs or SNPNs where N1 mode capability for 3GPP access was disabled.
input.question_ko: 3GPP access의 N1 mode capability가 비활성화된 경우 UE가 기억할 network identity를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the UE performs initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN or is registered for onboarding services in SNPN, the UE NAS layer shall not provide the lower layers with an NSSAI.
input.question_ko: SNPN onboarding service를 위해 initial registration을 수행하거나 이미 등록된 UE의 NAS layer가 lower layer에 NSSAI를 제공하는 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the UE is registering or registered for onboarding services in SNPN, the serving SNPN shall not provide a configured NSSAI to the UE.
input.question_ko: UE가 SNPN onboarding service에 등록 중이거나 등록된 경우 serving SNPN의 configured NSSAI 제공 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The N38 references point can be between V-SMFs in the same VPLMN, or between V-SMFs in different VPLMNs (to enable inter-PLMN mobility).
input.question_ko: V-SMF 사이 N38 reference point의 VPLMN 배치 관계를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: For 3GPP access and CM-CONNECTED state, when radio access network determines target RAT and target PLMN during Handover or redirection procedure, it should take per PLMN RAT restriction into consideration.
input.question_ko: CM-CONNECTED 상태의 3GPP access에서 handover 또는 redirection 중 target RAT·PLMN을 정할 때 고려할 제한을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: The AMF shall then include the message authentication code, selected NAS algorithms, NCC and generated ngKSI in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE (see subclause 9.11.2.9).
input.question_ko: S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE에 AMF가 포함하는 보안 정보를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: An UE connected to a 5G-RG or FN-RG can access to the 5GC via the N3IWF or via the TNGF where the combination of 5G-RG/FN-RG, W-AGF and UPF serving the 5G-RG or FN-RG is acting respectively as Untrusted Non-3GPP access network or as a Trusted Non-3GPP access network defined in clause 4.2.8.2; for example a UE is connecting to 5G-RG by means of WLAN radio access and connected to 5GC via N3IWF.
input.question_ko: 5G-RG 또는 FN-RG에 연결된 UE의 5GC non-3GPP 접근 경로를 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: Subscriptions targeted to Any UE shall not be moved to another AMF due to UE mobility.
input.question_ko: Any UE를 대상으로 하는 subscription을 UE mobility 때문에 다른 AMF로 이동하는 정책을 설명해줘.

input.source_text_en: If the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network was incorrect, the network should respond by sending a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE.
input.question_ko: network의 5G-GUTI와 SUPI mapping이 잘못된 경우 authentication 응답 절차를 설명해줘.
